name: brogent
description: Brogent — an Ollama-powered browser agent for Firefox.

scripts.package: bun run build.ts --target=firefox --no-sourcemap && bun run scripts/package.ts
scripts.package:chrome: bun run build.ts --target=chrome --no-sourcemap && bun run scripts/package.ts --chrome
scripts.package:all: bun run build.ts --target=all --no-sourcemap && bun run scripts/package.ts && bun run scripts/package.ts --chrome
scripts.dev:firefox: bun run build.ts --target=firefox && bunx --bun web-ext run --source-dir dist
